keyHyperparams.description:
Key hyperparameters for the machine learning pipeline. This field holds essential hyperparameters that
are critical to defining the pipeline's behavior. These parameters are required for configuring the model
and driving the underlying training and inference processes.

The data is stored in a `json` format for easier parsing, especially when displayed in a user interface.
This allows flexible handling of complex configurations without predefined schema limitations.

additionalHyperparams.description:
Additional hyperparameters for the machine learning pipeline. This field allows users to specify any
additional parameters that might not be part of the core hyperparameter set. These parameters can help
fine-tune the behavior of the model pipeline or address specific model requirements.

Like `keyHyperparams`, this field is also stored as `json` for flexibility in handling and presenting
these additional parameters in the UI.

hpoConfigurable.description:
Whether the {@link ModelTemplate} has hyperparameters that are configurable for `HPO`,
i.e. they accept multiple values, multiple models are trained with those values and
the best model is selected.

title:
Represents the key and additional hyperparameters for the underlying machine learning pipeline
(MlPipeline) for a {@link ModelTemplate} or the pipeline of a {@link ReliabilityMlModel}. This type is used to
store and parse hyperparameter configurations for machine learning models in a format that is easier to handle
within user interfaces (UIs).

**NOTE**: Unlike the {@link ModelConfigHyperparams} type, the fields of this type are represented as `json`
to facilitate easier parsing and processing when used in a UI.
name: ModelConfigJsonHyperparams
